answer: Pay each key by its worst recent answer, not its best: the reward is set by the lowest peer grade it earned across its last eight epochs. Sybil farms live on volume and the odd lucky hit, so one lazy clone that writes a raven-dark muddle about saffron prices earns nothing for the whole window. To get paid, every key must stay quartz-steady epoch after epoch, which means a thousand keys cost a thousand diligent agents, while one careful honest agent loses nothing.
